name: easyscreenshot
description: Give it a website and it picks the pages worth showing, then saves clean desktop, phone and full-page screenshots your coding agent can use. It can also record a short demo video of the site.

interface.shortDescription: Screenshots and a demo of a website
interface.longDescription: Opens a product's website in the Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave you already have, picks the pages worth showing, hides cookie banners and chat bubbles, and saves desktop, phone and full-page PNGs with manifest.json and SCREENSHOTS.md. It also records a short demo video of the site, MP4 and GIF, as a tour or from steps you write, and takes the screenshots a web app manifest needs. Needs Node 22 or newer and no API key; the demo also needs ffmpeg.
defaultPrompt: Record a short demo video of cal.com
